meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目：添加、搜索、修复、调试、美化、组合界面（包括聊天界面）。会先读取项目配置和已装组件，再查询组件文档，并遵循样式、表单、结构等代码规则来产出或修正代码。
howto.when: 当你处理 shadcn/ui 组件、提到 preset 或 --preset 代码、项目含 components.json，或要求“shadcn init”“用 --preset 创建应用”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我在项目里添加一个登录表单组件
say.note: 会先查项目上下文再执行 add 命令

say.text: 搜索一下有没有可用的聊天组件
say.note: 会用 search 命令查询注册表

say.text: 把我这个对话框改成 Sheet 侧边栏
say.note: 会按规则重构并检查代码

howto.what_en: Manages shadcn components and projects: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. It first reads project config and installed components, then fetches component docs, and follows styling/form/structure rules to produce or correct code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with shadcn/ui components, mentioning preset or --preset codes, when the project has components.json, or when asked to run shadcn init or use --preset to create/switch apps.

say_en.text: Add a login form component to my project.
say_en.note: It checks project context first, then runs add.

say_en.text: Search for any chat components available.
say_en.note: It queries registries with the search command.

say_en.text: Convert this dialog into a Sheet side panel.
say_en.note: It refactors and verifies against the rules.
